Milacron is looking for a Field Service Technician to join our team in Tennessee and surrounding areas. As a Field Service Technician, you will be responsible for providing quality installations, maintenance, and repairs of plastic injection/extrusion equipment. Breakdowns will require troubleshooting of mechanical, hydraulic, and electrical components and circuits.
 
Work You’ll Do:

Troubleshoot and repair plastic injection/extrusion equipment using online/offline applications (Industry 4.0/ Automation studio).
Perform schedule preventative maintenance activities on equipment.
Effectively interface with customers in repairing equipment as needed.
Evaluate and make recommendations regarding required repairs.
Install computer software programs to manufactured machines.
Load programs into equipment.
Utilize administrative tools (Concur, Sales Force, ADP)
Properly fill out start up sheets, calibration certificates, and PM documents.
Other duties may be assigned.

 
Team:

This role will be part of the Aftermarket Service team and report directly to the Regional Service Manager.

 
Basic Qualifications:

2+ years of experience working with hydraulics, mechanics, electrics, controls, and/or similar skillsets.
Willingness to travel and work overtime as necessary.
Willingness to be out a week at a time.  Possibility of 2 weeks if required.
Willingness to train/extended stay in Batavia, Ohio where our assembly headquarters is located.
Ability to read mechanical blueprints and electrical schematics.
Possess an active driver’s license and free of any restrictions related to driving offenses and based on initial and annual driver MVR reviews as defined by our fleet policy.

 
Preferred Qualifications:

2+ years of experience working with plastic injection/extrusion equipment or similar types of equipment or machine tool.
Good overall mechanical, electrical, and computer skills.

 
Physical Demands:

To perform this job successfully, the physical demands listed are representative of those that must be met by an employee. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, use hands to handle and feel, reach with hands and arms, talk, and hear. The employee may occasionally be required to crouch. The employee may occasionally lift items as heavy as 50 lbs. Specific vision abilities may include the employee’s ability to see near and far distances.
Must be comfortable in working in heights (on occasion)

Milacron is looking for a Senior Engineering Manager - Extrusion (Die Head & Tooling) to join our team in Batavia, OH. In this position, you will lead the engineering and technology function for the Extrusion Tooling business, with full ownership of die head design, tooling performance, and new product development. You will oversee engineering teams across the United States and work closely with the India Engineering Team to deliver reliable, high-quality, and cost-effective extrusion solutions.
Work You’ll Do:

Provide overall technical ownership of extrusion tooling product lines, including die head design, tooling components, and system performance.
Lead and direct engineering teams across the U.S. and India, setting priorities, assigning work, and ensuring on-time, high-quality delivery.
Drive new product development efforts, including concept development, design, prototyping, validation, and production readiness.
Support production and field service by troubleshooting tooling and die head performance issues, implementing root cause solutions and long-term improvements.
Partner with sales, operations, manufacturing, and product management to support customer needs, improve product quality, and drive cost optimization initiatives.

Qualifications:

Must Have:

8+ years of engineering experience with demonstrated leadership responsibility.
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Manufacturing Engineering.
Strong experience with plastic extrusion processing, extrusion machinery, and die head/tooling design.
Working knowledge of polymer behavior, melt flow, and extrusion performance.
Experience supporting full product development lifecycle, including new product development and sustaining engineering.
Strong problem-solving skills with experience in structured methods (root cause analysis, 8D, etc.).
Ability to lead cross-functional teams and communicate effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.




Nice to Have:

MBA or advanced business degree.
Experience with DTV, VAVE, or cost optimization initiatives.
Experience with CAD tools such as Creo, Windchill, SolidWorks, or AutoCAD.
Experience with simulation tools such as ANSYS or CFD software.
Experience working with global teams and multi-site engineering organizations.

Position Summary
The Project Manager is responsible for leading and executing complex cross-functional projects across Milacron using industry-standard project management tools, methodologies, and governance frameworks. This role serves as a key execution partner to Engineering, Product Management, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and Commercial teams, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, with high quality, and in alignment with business objectives. The Project Manager drives accountability, risk management, stakeholder communication, and execution discipline to deliver measurable business outcomes. 
 
Key Responsibilities / Objectives

Lead & Manage end-to-end industrial project lifecycle including concept, design reviews, procurement, manufacturing readiness, installation, commissioning, handover, and closure.


Develop comprehensive project plans including scope, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, resources, schedules, and risk mitigation strategies.
Drive and control change management process for any change In CTQ
Use proactive risk mitigation planning techniques
Serve as the primary project lead coordinating activities across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Product Management, Quality, and Commercial functions.
Drive project governance, accountability, and timely decision-making through regular project reviews and stakeholder engagement.
Manage project risks, issues, constraints, and critical path activities, proactively identifying mitigation and recovery plans.
Own project communications, status reporting, executive updates, and stakeholder management.
Ensure project deliverables meet defined quality, cost, and schedule requirements.
Support New Product Introduction (NPI), engineering changes, manufacturing readiness, process improvement initiatives, cost reduction projects, and operational transformation programs.
Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and resolve project roadblocks through influence and effective communication.
Track project performance through dashboards, KPIs, action logs, and project health metrics.
Ensure adherence to standardized project management methodologies, templates, and governance processes.
Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance execution excellence and speed-to-market.
Manage external suppliers, consultants, and service partners when applicable.
Ensure process compliance at each review stage ensuring the project is within the defined scope
Should be able to control all 9 management areas in project management 
Introduce both predictive and preventive KPI for projects 

 
Leadership Scope
This role operates across multiple functions and business units, influencing project outcomes without direct reporting authority. The Project Manager works closely with business leaders and project stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery while maintaining alignment with strategic business objectives. 
 
Skills & Experience

12+ years of overall professional experience.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Project Management, Program Management, or Technical Project Management.
Proven experience leading complex cross-functional projects within manufacturing, industrial equipment, engineered products, machine design, or product development environments.
Strong understanding of project planning, execution, risk management, change management, and stakeholder communication.
Experience working in global, matrix-based organizations and leading teams through influence.
Demonstrated success in delivering projects on time, within budget, and meeting business objectives.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication capabilities.
Proficiency in project management software and Microsoft Office tools.
Working knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and manufacturing processes preferred.


Strong exposure to heavy industry, manufacturing operations, industrial equipment, capital projects, or engineered-to-order product environments.
Working knowledge of safety, quality, cost, delivery, and compliance requirements in factory, shop-floor, or heavy engineering environments.
Experience coordinating with engineering, production, supply chain, quality, service, and external suppliers to resolve constraints impacting schedule, cost, quality, or technical performance.
Ability to lead technical reviews, manufacturing feasibility checks, design-change impact assessments, and stage-gate readiness reviews.
Strong understanding of supplier follow-up, long-lead item tracking, BOM readiness, capacity constraints, and industrial project dependency management.

Education

Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Operations, Manufacturing, Business, or a related discipline required.
PMP Certification is mandatory.
MBA or Postgraduate qualification in Business Management, Operations, or Project Management will be an added advantage. 

Travel
Approximately 15-20% domestic and international travel may be required based on project and business needs.
 
Core Competencies

Project & Program Execution
Cross-Functional Leadership
Stakeholder Management
Risk & Issue Management
Change Management
Strategic Planning & Execution
Technical & Operational Acumen
Executive Communication
Problem Solving & Decision Making
Continuous Improvement

 
Physical Demands
The physical demands described are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.
The role involves standard office work including sitting, standing, walking, speaking, and use of computers and communication tools. Occasional lifting of items up to 10 lbs may be required. 
 
Disclaimer
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties or responsibilities. Management reserves the right to modify responsibilities as business needs evolve.

Milacron is looking for a Director of Aftermarket Operations (US) to join our team in Batavia, OH. In this position, you will be responsible for driving above market revenue growth through exceptional leadership skills in field service and retrofit/rebuild (R&R) management. Scope of role is inclusive of strategy development, value capture project management, digital solution adoption, and sales execution. You will have overall responsibility for the company’s aftermarket operations team, which is a blend of customer-facing activities as well as operational execution. You will have responsibility for the quality and volume of service provided, expanding Milacron’s R&R portfolio, and drive aftermarket growth initiatives for the organization across the United States. The ideal candidate will have significant experience in a manufacturing equipment and service environment. Technical and customer service experience with the repair of capital equipment, such as plastic injection molding, is highly preferred.   
Relocation assistance may be provided for those that reside outside of the Greater Cincinnati area.
Work You'll Do: 

Drive aftermarket revenue growth through data-driven strategy, digital tools, and AI to increase market share, attachment rates, and margin.
Lead and execute aftermarket strategies, offerings, and initiatives in partnership with strategic accounts, regional sales, and marketing.
Own and optimize the end-to-end aftermarket quote-to-order process (parts, service, retrofit/rebuild), leveraging automation and AI for speed, accuracy, and scalability.
Deliver on Milacron’s Value Creation Plan (VCP) by streamlining processes, improving forecast accuracy, and enhancing customer experience.
Provide strong financial leadership, including budgeting, forecasting, pricing/discount governance, and profitability management.
Lead, develop, and train high-performing teams; structure effective training programs and ensure strong productivity and resource allocation.
Quarterback business-critical and cross-functional projects that improve sales effectiveness, operational efficiency, and revenue generation.
Act as the customer advocate by deeply understanding customer needs across the value chain; own NPS and drive continuous improvement in satisfaction and demand.
Oversee aftermarket operations including parts forecasting, inventory, warehousing, market intelligence, and working capital optimization.
Communicate clearly and consistently with executive leadership on performance, risks, gaps, and strategic needs for the aftermarket business.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in sales, marketing, business or engineering, Master’s degree preferred
Professional experience of 10+ years in a progressively responsible sales management position
Demonstrated track record of leading the growth of an aftermarket business; Experience developing and marketing new Aftermarket solutions is desirable
Knowledge of technical/industrial equipment, plastics and/or plastics machines is a plus
Solid leadership and matrix team management skills are required
Experience upgrading teams, processes and systems, and as well as effective problem-solving skills are key
Experience with negotiations, scheduling, and project management
Proven use of digital strategies to drive expansion of the business

Position Summary:-
The Sr. Director of Injection Machinery Sales, Marketing & Aftermarket holds responsibility for all sales functions in India. The position will be located in Ahmedabad, India
The primary responsibility of this role is to lead and manage Sales Teams to meet or exceed sales revenue, sales profitability, and budgetary objectives. The role involves strategic planning, managing people, selling, leveraging technology, and improving Milacron's Injection Machinery market share. The Sr. Director will develop and implement integrated sales strategies that align with the company's daily, monthly, quarterly, and long-range plans, as well as develop and drive sales forecasts and KPI's that grow our business. Beyond day-to-day sales leadership, the Sr. Director will serve as the business leader for a large-scale, multi-year sales and commercial transformation in India — modernising the go-to-market model, integrating sales and marketing, and liaising closely across Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, Engineering, Aftermarket, and Marketing to deliver step-change, sustainable growth.
 
Work You’ll Do:

Develops a sales strategy that meets company objectives and customer expectations.
Works as a team with Plant Operations, NPD, BI, Aftermarket (AM), Quality, and Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and Supply Chain to advance efforts to efficiently expedite the fulfillment of complex or high-priority sales orders.
Creates sales budgets & forecasts for India and Home export regions of Africa, Middle East and SAARC. 
Evaluates and regularly reports on sales targets and leading/lagging indicators for his/her team.
Acts as a senior leader, leading by example and forging strong cross-functional relationships across the organization and with our customers
Leads team environments that value diversity and inclusion with talent development at all levels.
Develops new business opportunities that maximize revenue throughout the region.
Identify market volatility in assigned territory and develop sales strategies to adapt to the changing business environment.
Manages teams to deliver consistent quarter to quarter sales needed to achieve revenue targets for the company.
Uses metrics to develop, manage, and grow team/business across all geographies and borders.
Create a culture of success, ongoing business development, and goal achievement for sales teams.
Drive business development and increase market share through integrated sales and marketing initiatives, digital enablement, and technology adoption.
Uses the appropriate mix of sales strategies and processes that match the needs and receptiveness of customers in varying market segments.
Lead and orchestrate a large-scale, multi-year sales and commercial transformation program — spanning go-to-market redesign, sales and marketing integration, CRM and digital enablement, pricing, and channel strategy — mobilising cross-functional teams and liaising across Plant Operations, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, NPD, BI, Aftermarket, Quality, and Engineering.
Design and lead integrated sales and marketing efforts — including demand generation, brand and product positioning, campaign execution, channel and partner programs, and lead-to-order management — to build a qualified pipeline and accelerate conversion.
Establish and run transformation governance — steering committees, a program/PMO cadence, milestone and benefit tracking, and structured change management — to sequence initiatives, align stakeholders, and sustain results over the long term.
The role requires high levels of strategic sales vision, transformational leadership, critical thinking, high energy, organization, negotiation and sales strategies, and judgement based on overall business development experience to execute key functions.
The role requires adequate level of discretion/decision making to make apt decisions that have a direct and major impact on the operation and financial well-being of the business.

 
Basic Qualifications:
 
Education and Experience

BE/BTech with MBA from TIER 1 Business School.
Must have 15-20 years of experience in Technical Sales/Business Development leadership role managing sales revenues of $50Milllion USD as a minimum in industrial equipment space. Must also have demonstrated experience leading or playing a lead role in large-scale, cross-functional transformation or change initiatives spanning sales, marketing, and operations.

 
Preferred Qualifications:

Experience implementing large-scale initiatives and tracking results.  
Demonstrated success leading large-scale business or commercial transformation programs — go-to-market redesign, sales and marketing integration, CRM/digital enablement, pricing, and process standardisation — with measurable, sustained business impact.
Strong program- and change-management capability, including PMO/governance design, stakeholder alignment, and milestone/benefit tracking across a multi-year roadmap.
Proven ability to build and lead an integrated sales and marketing engine — demand generation, product marketing, channel and partner programs, and pricing — in a technical, industrial B2B environment.
Experience liaising with and driving alignment across diverse functions (Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, Engineering, Marketing, Aftermarket, and Quality) within a matrixed, multi-region organization.
Ability to work across all levels and lead through influence.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills required; ability to recommend alternative solutions and translate complex concepts into simplified and understandable examples.
Strong financial acumen.
Must have proven ability to mentor, coach, direct, and assess groups/teams to utilize tools and increase productivity.
Experience in managing a large, diverse team across multiple business units.
Excellent leadership skills, as evidenced by a track record of hiring, retaining, developing, and motivating top sales talent.
Proven track record of identifying sales opportunities within new and existing accounts; identifying, managing, and solving conflicts with clients; and meeting deadlines.
Proven success managing profit and loss.
Experience with low volume manufacturing and a high mix product offering/highly technical portfolio.
Ability to translate a sales strategy into specific team objectives.
Advanced knowledge of technical sales to customers.
Ability to travel.
